pages: Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, kneels on the wet slate ledge with her hand flat on the open rock pool book. Middle distance: a stub of pencil, a measuring staff standing in the shallow green water. Background: the slipway above, low evening sun.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, stands on the slipway holding the closed rock pool book out in both hands. Middle distance: a clear plastic bag hanging open, the slate ledge below. Background: grey April sea, a flat wet sky. Soft overcast light on the anorak.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, holds one printed survey sheet in both hands, one red mark on it. Middle distance: the rock pool book under her arm, a rolled council letter. Background: the slate ledge and the tide below, blown July light.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, kneels at the pool's edge with one hand over a cluster of closed beadlet anemones, drawn in tight. Middle distance: fresh water running off the road bank, a roll of wire mesh. Background: the slate ledge, grey sea. Flat wet light.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair loose, a red jumper, lies under a blanket holding one small torch on the open rock pool book. Middle distance: the bed edge, a bedside lamp turned low. Background: a dark bedroom window, black night. Torchlight across the paper, one column of neat capitals.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, stands in the shallow pool holding one painted depth staff upright against her shoulder. Middle distance: the rock pool book on the ledge, a copper thermometer. Background: the slate ledge, the slipway, low evening sun on the water.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, lifts one copper-cased thermometer out of a scrape of water two fingers deep. Middle distance: closed anemones like closed fists, the rock pool book on the ledge. Background: bare wet slate, cold morning light.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, writes in the rock pool book seated on the step of a dark porch, red hands round the pencil. Middle distance: dripping wellingtons, a kitchen window lit behind her. Background: the slate ledge and black water. Pre-dawn cold blue light.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, stands at the back of a parked van with one hand flat on the survey sheet. Middle distance: the big book open on the tailgate, her rock pool book. Background: the slipway, the pool below, flat Sunday daylight.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red jumper, leans over a kitchen table with one pencil in her hand over the open rock pool book, line by line. Middle distance: a grey rubber smear across one number, a folded council form. Background: a window going dark, a lamp on the table. Warm lamplight.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red jumper, writes on the last leaf of the open rock pool book at the kitchen table, pencil going down the columns. Middle distance: the copper thermometer, a grey smear across one number. Background: a dark window, a chair pushed back. Warm lamplight on the paper.

Maren Oke, a girl of nine, dark hair in one plait, a red anorak to her knees, green wellingtons, walks up the slipway with the rock pool book under her arm, wet at the corners. Middle distance: the black rock pool below, a measuring staff in it. Background: grey sea, a low horizon. Cold evening light on the anorak.
